note: Machine-readable replacement for gates that used to grep prose markers ("R219", "P513-Q1", "v50.89 ... semantic review") inside RULES.md, QA-CHECKLIST.md, BUG-POSTMORTEM.md and CHANGELOG.md. Each policy names the ledger ids it traces to and the gate scripts that actually enforce it. scripts/ci-workflow-compaction-check.mjs verifies that every enforcing gate exists and is wired into architecture/qa-pipeline.json, and that every rule id is still a RULES.md heading. Ledger prose can be compressed or reworded freely; deleting the enforcing gate or unwiring it is what fails.

policies.summary: An audit/gate pass is not semantic review; release claims stay fail-closed until line-level semantic coverage is certified.
Workflow memory is compacted: default preflight stays under 64 KiB and large ledgers are search-only, routed through INDEX.
Producer, workflow and consumer data contracts (freshness, provenance, publish boundaries) are gate-enforced.
Default routes carry no flow noise or auto-fill grids; operator note leads the home route; visual hierarchy is not a one-note terminal style.
Live workspace facts come from the generated _context/CURRENT-STATE.md and CONTEXT-CATALOG.json, never hand-copied into guides.
Agent hooks block destructive commands and give advisory checks only; no hook commits, pushes or deploys.
